items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: I remember once we made a tour with Big Joe Turner. He was on tour with us.

ctx.x: Because my sister had just had a little baby girl. Her name is Jackie, she's in New York now. And I was so crazy about this, my little niece that I called the first number I made for Basie 'Baby Girl', for Jackie. And it was pretty good. A pretty good number.

items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: We went over for the State Department. Just Joe Turner and I. We went from England over there to play.

ctx.x: Now what were you doing in Yugoslavia? Was that a festival?
We went over for the State Department. Just Joe Turner and I. We went from England over there to play.
You mean Joe Turner the blues singer?
